steps.title: Enter Indigo Diagnostics mode
steps.body: Oven must be cool. Press HOME → FAVORITES → LIGHT three times in a row (repeat the same three-key sequence until Diagnostics enters). After each test, press CANCEL to return to clock and re-enter as needed. Timeout: 5 minutes idle returns to time-of-day.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Diagnostics Mode by pressing HOME>FAVORITES>LIGHT (repeat three times).
